notes.title: Small bug fixes - Mar 30 2025
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug on level 10, when switching from the fake version of the level to the real one (from the intro to the main part), the chance of spawning crosses remained several times less than it should.
 Fixed cursor disappearing if you open and close pause after death.
 Fixed disappearance of the interface after death when applying some settings.

notes.title: The Future City Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320460/0f5f92d79d799cfe3e19e5a5a23a4fffc4f020e7.png
Content:
Major Level 6 rework:

The level has been greatly increased in size. Previous size: 40X20 blocks within the level. New size: 60X40
The buildings on the sides have been heavily redesigned. New types of blocks have been added, including decorative blocks. Instead of stuffy, small mazes, the buildings now contain small offices that conveniently allow you to get to the top of the level
3 new types of flying cars spawn in the level:

Wide: slower, most often appearing at the bottom of the level, reducing the player's chances of dying from falling out of the level
“Trampoline” car: when stepping on the roof of such a car, the player is thrown high up, helping to quickly return to the top of the level. It is also prioritized to spawn at the bottom
Hybrid: combines the features of the previous two.

The background of the level has been updated and expanded
To summarize: the level has become more spacious, varied, and fun to play through thanks to the new additions

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320460/175a96a078b79d0aea79288360f4a8ac16449bac.png

Bugs:

Fixed player mobility scale disappearing after resurrection
Fixed a bug with the color of the displayed number of golden crosses when getting an achievement at the moment of death
Fixed interface behavior when pausing the game at the moment of death

notes.title: The first hotfix
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/hn1tDYs.png
- Spawned crosses now disappear when the player is resurrected to avoid instant death
- Fixed the inability to click the post-death interface buttons with the mouse on some levels
- The text of an achievement just obtained now starts scrolling after 2 seconds instead of instantly if it doesn't fit in the textbox.
- Fixed golden crosses spawning on level 8
- Fixed crosses progression bug on level 10
- Fixed level 10 ending
- Some minor fixes
